```{r results='hide', echo=FALSE}
loadLibrary = function(packageName, suppressMessages = TRUE, githubRepo = NULL)
 {
  if (! require(packageName, character.only = TRUE)) {
    if (! is.null(githubRepo)) {
      loadLibrary("devtools")
      devtools::install_github(githubRepo)    
    }
    else 
      install.packages(packageName)
  
    if (suppressMessages)
      suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(packageName, character.only = TRUE))
    else 
      library(packageName, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}
```

Converting string columns to numeric

```{r}
columns_to_convert <- c("confidenceSection", "credibilitySection", "responseSection", "shareSection", "trialEndTime","trialStartTime", "commentSection", "duration", "confidence", "share", "slider-confidence-start", "slider-share-start", "age")
trialData[, columns_to_convert] <- lapply(trialData[, columns_to_convert], as.numeric)
```

Calculating the times for each of the questions

```{r}
trialData <- trialData %>% mutate(credTime = (confidenceSection - credibilitySection)/1000, 
                     confidenceTime= (shareSection - confidenceSection)/1000,
                     sharingTime = (commentSection-shareSection)/1000,
                     commentTime = (responseSection-commentSection)/1000,
                     onlineResponseTime = (trialEndTime-responseSection)/1000,
                     duration = duration/1000)
```

How many participants and how much time did they take?

```{r}
n_distinct(trialData$uid)
```

```{r}

durationSummary<-  trialData %>% select(uid, sonaID, duration, credTime,confidenceTime,sharingTime, onlineResponseTime,commentTime) %>% group_by(uid, sonaID) %>% summarize(
```

On average it seems to take 30 minutes per participant to complete the experiment.

```{r}
timeData <- trialData %>% select(uid, index,condition, mainHeadline, credTime, confidenceTime, sharingTime, onlineResponseTime, commentTime)

timeDataLong <-timeData %>% pivot_longer(cols = ends_with("Time"), names_to = 'TimeType', values_to = 'duration')

timeDataLong$TimeType <- factor(timeDataLong$TimeType, levels=c('credTime','confidenceTime','sharingTime','onlineResponseTime','commentTime'))
```

```{r}
ggplot(timeDataLong, aes(x=TimeType, y=duration)) + geom_boxplot() + scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(angle = 30)) + ylab("Duration (Seconds)") + xlab("Trial question") 
```

```{r}
timeDataLong <- timeDataLong %>%
  group_by(condition, TimeType) %>%
  filter(duration > quantile(duration, 0.25) & duration < quantile(duration, 0.75))
```

```{r}
ggplot(timeDataLong, aes(x=TimeType, y=duration)) + geom_boxplot() + scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(angle = 30)) + ylab("Duration (Seconds)") + xlab("Trial question") 
```

```{r}
shareRatingSummary <-trialData %>% select(groundTruth, share) %>% group_by(groundTruth) %>% summarise(count = n(),
                         mean = mean(share),
                         sd = sd(share),
                         se = sd/sqrt(count),
                         ci = se * qt((1-0.05)/2 + .5, count-1))

shareRatingSummary
```

```{r}
ggplot(shareRatingSummary, aes(x=groundTruth, y=mean)) + 
    geom_bar(position=position_dodge(), stat="identity", width = .7) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=mean-ci, ymax=mean+ci),
                  width=.2,                    # Width of the error bars
                  position=position_dodge(.7)) + 
   ylab("Mean Share Rating") + xlab("Ground Truth") + 
   theme_bw()  + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, vjust = 1, hjust=1))
```

```{r}
temp <- trialData %>% select(mainHeadline,headlineText,onlineResponse,percCredibility,groundTruth,confidence) %>% group_by(mainHeadline,headlineText,onlineResponse,percCredibility,groundTruth) %>% summarise(mConf = mean(confidence), count = n())

temp <- temp %>%  pivot_wider(
```

## Hypothesis and research questions

H1. Participants will give less corrective comments compared to reinforcing comments.

H2. Participants will be more discerning when giving corrective comments compared to reinforcing ones.

H3. Participants will be more confident in their credibility assessment

1.  a\. when giving comments compared to skipping.

2.  b\. when giving corrective comments compared to reinforcing.

## Analysis

#### H1 - Out of the corrective comments only a small proportion is given online compared to reinforcing comments.

```{r}
table(trialData$percCredibility, trialData$onlineResponse)
```

```{r}
prop.test(table(trialData$percCredibility, trialData$onlineResponse))
```

```{r}
power.prop.test(p1 = 0.87, p2 = 0.81, sig.level = 0.05, power = 0.8)
```

#### H2 - Participants will be more discerning when giving corrective comments compared to reinforcing ones.

```{r}
table(trialData$groundTruth, trialData$percCredibility)
```

```{r}
trialData <- trialData %>% mutate(classification = ifelse( groundTruth == 'FALSE' & percCredibility == 'percFalse', 'hit', ifelse(groundTruth == 'FALSE' & percCredibility != 'percFalse', 'miss',ifelse(groundTruth == 'TRUE' & percCredibility == 'percTrue', 'hit','miss'))))
temp <- trialData %>% filter(onlineResponse == 'onlineYes')

table(trialData$groundTruth, trialData$classification)
```

```{r}
table(temp$groundTruth, temp$percCredibility)
```

```{r}
table(temp$groundTruth, temp$classification)
```

```{r}
prop.test(table(temp$groundTruth, temp$classification))
```

#### H3

```{r}
trialData %>% select(percCredibility,onlineResponse, confidence) %>% group_by(percCredibility, onlineResponse) %>% summarise(mConf = mean(confidence), count = n(), sd=sd(confidence))
```

```{r}
leveneTest(confidence ~ interaction(percCredibility, onlineResponse), data = trialData)
```

```{r}
rep.Aov <- aov(confidence ~ percCredibility * onlineResponse, data = trialData)
summary(rep.Aov)

TukeyHSD(rep.Aov)
```

```{r}
etaSquared(rep.Aov)
```
